key_catalyst: Alphabet’s raised $195–205B AI-capex guidance and resulting after-hours selloff
reasoning: Alphabet’s sharply higher AI-capex guidance is a new, index-relevant earnings catalyst that turned a revenue beat into an after-hours selloff, while Tesla’s profit miss reinforces the broader mega-cap spending/returns concern.
